title: Fix the spacing in your app
summary: Make a cramped dashboard easier to scan without changing what it does.

assets.excerpt: A frame at 0:06.75 of the post video

prompts.text: Use the idea in this post: https://x.com/MichaelFilipiuk/status/2111383736243859714 (when an app feels off, fix the spacing: sidebar width, top space, gaps between items and padding inside cards). Make a backup copy of my original app first, then improve the spacing directly in the existing app without changing its content or features. Open the backup and the updated app in the browser so I can see before and after, and check that both work. Ask me before installing or loading anything.

made.alt: One dashboard changes in place: its sidebar widens, the page and sections gain space, the gaps between cards shrink, and padding inside each card grows. Coloured overlays and values show each change.
made.caption: Watch the real dashboard change in place, using measurements from a Hey Atu run.
